ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which part of the body lies just before the anus?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of the human digestive system. It can be seen that the food passage goes downward from the mouth through the esophagus, stomach, small intestine, and large intestine. The intestinal tract ends in the pelvic region below the trunk, and the lowest end is the position of the anus leading outside the body. Just above the anus there is a short segment of terminal intestine. Reasoning: The order of the digestive tract is that after the large intestine/colon it enters the rectum, and the rectum then leads to the anus. Therefore, the body part located before the anus is the rectum.
